title: Augustana Crowns Royals at 2026 Viking Days Coronation
summary_en: Augustana University students Vy Nguyen ‘27 and Ridge Fisher ‘27 were crowned the 2026 Viking Days Royals during a coronation ceremony Wednesday, Oct. 21, in the Elmen Center.
